category_description: Pay, leave and government payments for people who work in Canada.
subcategory_description: The minimum pay and leave that employees are entitled to.
label: Federal minimum wage per hour
context: Applies to employees in federally regulated workplaces under Part III of the Canada Labour Code. If the minimum wage set by the province or territory where the employee works is higher, the higher rate applies.

label: Most that can be deducted from wages for each meal
context: Applies only where the employee accepts room or board from the employer. The employer may then pay below the minimum wage, but cannot reduce wages by more than this for each meal.

label: Most that can be deducted from wages per day for living quarters
context: Applies only where the employee accepts room or board from the employer. The employer may then pay below the minimum wage, but cannot reduce wages by more than this per day for living quarters.

subject_intro: The federal minimum wage rate, which workplaces it covers, how it works with provincial and territorial rates, and what the federal rules say about salaried employees, call-in shifts and room and board.
subject_meta_description: The federal minimum wage is {fact:ca_mw_federal} an hour. See which workers it covers, how it changes each April 1 and how it works with provincial and territorial rates.
